title_en: Come On, Become a Stone, Jana
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Stanza 2 line 1 ('дибек би те кало') is unclear to me; my reading is that a dibek stone would be set for her. Treat that line as a guess.

words_to_learn.en: to become, to turn yourself into
stone block, mortar stone (my reading: mounting stone)

lines.cyr: Ајде камен Јано, камен бре душо,
lines.lat: Ajde kamen Jano, kamen bre dušo,
lines.en: Come on, become a stone, Jana, a stone, my dear,

lines.cyr: Јано в раце да ми падниш.
lines.lat: Jano v race da mi padniš.
lines.en: Jana, and fall into my hands.

lines.cyr: Ајде дибек би те кало бре Јано,
lines.lat: Ajde dibek bi te kalo bre Jano,
lines.en: Come on, a mounting stone would be set for you, hey Jana,

lines.cyr: Ај на дибек јас да стапнам бре Јано,
lines.lat: Aj na dibek jas da stapnam bre Jano,
lines.en: Come on, so I can step on the mounting stone, hey Jana,

lines.cyr: Јано на коњ да се качам,
lines.lat: Jano na konj da se kačam,
lines.en: Jana, to climb onto a horse,

lines.cyr: Ајде в Цариград да одам мори Јано,
lines.lat: Ajde v Carigrad da odam mori Jano,
lines.en: Come on, to go to Constantinople, hey Jana,
Jana, to buy you a necklace,
